description: This file defines data structures related to application configuration within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace, including application identifiers, arguments, port configurations, storage info, and communication socket path.

classes.name: ApplicationConfiguration
classes.description: Structure holding application configuration details such as app ID, instance ID, arguments, user and group IDs, ports, communication socket path, debug settings, and storage info.

classes.name: AppStorageInfo
classes.description: Structure representing storage information for an application, including path, user ID, group ID, size, and used space.
